title: Warehouse Receipt and Quality Certificate Extraction
summary: Extract and cross-check warehouse receipts, e-NWRs, quality certificates and stack details for commodity finance, so credit and collateral teams catch mismatches before disbursal.

seo.title: Warehouse Receipt and Quality Certificate AI | VipraTech
seo.description: AI that extracts warehouse receipts and assayer quality certificates, matches them to stacks and loan terms, and flags gaps for collateral managers.

problem.intro: Loans against stored commodities depend on documents that must agree with each other: the warehouse receipt or e-NWR, the assayer's quality certificate, stack cards, insurance cover and the loan terms. When these are checked by hand, a mismatch in quantity, grade or validity date can slip through until there is a problem with the stock.

pain_points.title: Documents that do not agree
pain_points.detail: Bag counts, net weight, variety or grade can differ between the receipt, the quality certificate and the stack card.

pain_points.title: Validity and tenure gaps
pain_points.detail: Receipts or insurance that expire before the loan matures create exposure that is easy to miss.

pain_points.title: Quality parameters buried in certificates
pain_points.detail: Moisture, foreign matter, damaged grains and other parameters appear in different layouts from different assayers.

pain_points.title: Manual re-keying across systems
pain_points.detail: The same receipt data is typed into the loan system, the collateral register and the MIS.

solution.overview: We build a pipeline that reads each commodity finance file: physical or electronic warehouse receipts, quality certificates, stack cards, insurance policies and the borrower's loan request. It extracts receipt number, depositor, warehouse, commodity, variety, quantity, weight, quality parameters and validity dates. The system then matches documents against each other and against the loan terms, checking quantities, grade, lien status, insurance and expiry dates. Quality parameters are compared with the lender's acceptance norms for that commodity. Each check links to its source on the page. Clean files move to the loan system; mismatches and borderline quality results go to the collateral manager's exception queue, with an audit trail of every change.
capabilities: Extracts warehouse receipt, e-NWR and stack card fields
Reads quality certificates from different assayers into one schema
Matches quantity, weight, commodity and grade across documents
Checks receipt, insurance and loan tenure dates
Compares quality parameters with commodity acceptance norms
Exception queue and audit trail for collateral managers

workflow.title: Receive the finance file
workflow.detail: Receipts, certificates, stack cards and insurance documents arrive from the warehouse provider, a repository statement or the borrower.

workflow.title: Extract fields
workflow.detail: Each document is classified and its fields extracted with confidence scores and page references.

workflow.title: Cross-match documents
workflow.detail: Quantities, commodity, grade and dates are matched across all documents in the file.

workflow.title: Check against loan terms
workflow.detail: Validity, insurance, lien status and quality parameters are compared with the loan request and acceptance norms.

workflow.title: Exception review
workflow.detail: Mismatches and borderline results go to the collateral manager, who confirms, corrects or rejects.

workflow.title: Hand over to the loan system
workflow.detail: Structured collateral data and the audit trail move to the loan and collateral systems.

human_in_the_loop: Collateral managers and credit officers review every mismatch, borderline quality result and expiry gap. Disbursal decisions and physical stock inspection remain with the lender and its collateral manager.
integrations: e-NWR repository statements, where the lender has access
guardrails: No disbursal decision made by the system

compliance_notes: Designed for lending against receipts issued by warehouses registered under the Warehousing (Development and Regulation) Act 2007 and regulated by WDRA.
Keeps an audit trail that supports internal audit and RBI expectations on credit documentation.

faqs.q: Does it work with electronic warehouse receipts?
faqs.a: Yes. It can read e-NWR details from repository statements or exports where your institution has access, and match them against the paper documents in the file.

faqs.q: Can it replace physical stock inspection?
faqs.a: No. It checks that the documents agree and are valid. Physical verification by your collateral manager or warehouse auditor is still needed.

faqs.q: How are different assayers' certificates handled?
faqs.a: Each certificate layout is mapped to one schema, so moisture, foreign matter and other parameters are compared the same way whichever assayer issued them. New layouts are added as they appear.
In your cloud account or an India region of a major cloud provider. Access is role-based, and models are configured not to retain or train on your data.
